entradas.text: I called Marcel Koronti.
entradas.menu: Call Marcel Koronti.

entradas.text: I decided not to call Marcel.
entradas.menu: Do nothing.

entradas.text: If Marcel's cartel ties were real, this was huge news. My deal with him aside, HOS was the largest corporation in all of Sordland.
I had to be careful. More so than ever.
He answered right away.
“Mr. President.”
“I have some information that could be useful to you.”
entradas.menu: “I have some information that could be useful to you.”

entradas.text: “The government is launching an indepth investigation into HOS. Soon.”
entradas.menu: “The government is launching an indepth investigation into HOS. Soon.”

entradas.text: “Oh? Now I'm excited.”
“What is it?”
“Really? Who would be behind such a thing?”
“I just prevented my own government from launching an investigation into HOS. I'm not sure how long I can keep them at bay.”
entradas.menu: “I just prevented my own government from launching an investigation into HOS. I'm not sure how long I can keep them at bay.”

entradas.text: “Well, well. Thank you for doing that.”
“Lileas Graf.”
entradas.menu: “Lileas Graf.”

entradas.text: “Me.”
entradas.menu: “Me.”

entradas.text: “Then why are you calling me?”
“What an unfortunate turn of events.”
“Is it true that you have links to the Koranelli cartel?”
entradas.menu: “Is it true that you have links to the Koranelli cartel?”

entradas.text: “Of course not.”
He started laughing hysterically.
“I wonder whose plan is it to remove me from my position this time.”
“I have many enemies, Mr. President. Probably as many as you do. I had no dealings with a *cartel*. I assure you.”
“That's all I wanted to know.”
entradas.menu: “That's all I wanted to know.”

entradas.text: “What are you offering for this information?”
entradas.menu: “What are you offering for this information?”

entradas.text: “Well, I don't think I can make an offer without seeing what I am buying first.”
“Too bad, then. See you Marcel.”
entradas.menu: “Too bad, then. See you Marcel.”

entradas.text: “Wait.”
“How important is this *information*?”
“Let's just say it's important enough that I am calling you.”
entradas.menu: “Let's just say it's important enough that I am calling you.”

entradas.text: I hung up on Marcel.
entradas.menu: Hang up.

entradas.text: “Fair enough. Hmm.”
“Let's do this then. I promise you campaign funds. The amount, however, will be dependent on the value of the information.”
“Deal.”
entradas.menu: “Deal.”

entradas.text: “Very well. What is the information then?”
“On second thought, I just wanted to test you. I will come visit you when you are behind bars.”
entradas.menu: “On second thought, I just wanted to test you. I will come visit you when you are behind bars.”

entradas.text: “Mr. Presi-.”
I hung up on Marcel.
“What is this about?”
“The government is launching a serious investigation into HOS. Very soon."
entradas.menu: “The government is launching a serious investigation into HOS. Very soon."

entradas.text: “I just prevented my own government from launching an investigation into HOS. I'm not sure how long I can keep them at bay.”
entradas.menu: “I just prevented my own government from launching an investigation into HOS. I'm not sure how long I can keep them at bay.”

entradas.text: “Well, well. Thank you for doing that.”
“That is indeed valuable information. I will make good use of it indeed."
“Well, well. Thank you for telling me.”
“As I have promised, I will deliver again on our deal when the time is right. Just as I have always done."
“I must now make sure my people are on this.”
“Cheers to our deal once again, Mr. President, and to many more years of collaboration.”
“Bye bye, now.”
Marcel hung up.
“The government is launching an indepth investigation into HOS. Soon."
entradas.menu: “The government is launching an indepth investigation into HOS. Soon."

entradas.text: “I just prevented my own government from launching an investigation into HOS. I'm not sure how long I can keep them at bay.”
entradas.menu: “I just prevented my own government from launching an investigation into HOS. I'm not sure how long I can keep them at bay.”

entradas.text: “Well, well. Thank you for doing that.”
“Well, well. Thank you for telling me.”
"Here's what I can offer in exchange for your help.”
“I promise you campaign funds commensurate with the value of your information."
“I don't need your help to win.”
entradas.menu: “I don't need your help to win.”

entradas.text: “Deal.”
entradas.menu: “Deal.”

entradas.text: “I have no doubt. Very well.”
“Perfect.”
“Please let me know then if you ever need help.”
“You will learn soon. Goodbye, Marcel.”
entradas.menu: “You will learn soon. Goodbye, Marcel.”

entradas.text: “Now, I wouldn't like to stay indebted to you.”
“Consider this a token of goodwill.”
entradas.menu: “Consider this a token of goodwill.”

entradas.text: “That is certainly a bargain. Very well, I shall do so.”
“Please let me know if you ever need help.”
I hung up on Marcel.
“Thank you for telling me.”
The games Marcel was playing were getting more and more dangerous.
The question was, who would be the winner?
The games Marcel was playing were getting more and more dangerous.
Nia Morgna requested to set up an off-the-books meeting to relay a new development from the criminal investigations conducted by the Anti-Corruption Police.
She was seated right across from me in the meeting room.
“Mr. President.”
Lileas Graf requested to set up an off-the-books meeting to relay a new development from the criminal investigations conducted by the Secret State Police.
She was seated right across from me in the meeting room.
“Mr. President.”
She handed over a police report detailing the network of the Koranelli gang in the city.
“Thanks to Mr. Greiser's efforts, we have come across a suspicious link during our recent operations against organised crime in Estord.”
“You asked the SSP to start investigating the Oligarchs.”
“We couldn't find anything related to Walter Tusk yet, but there is a silver lining.”
“This is a very big accusation, are you absolutely sure?”
entradas.menu: “This is a very big accusation, are you absolutely sure?”

entradas.text: “Without undeniable evidence there is no point in making assumptions.”
entradas.menu: “Without undeniable evidence there is no point in making assumptions.”

entradas.text: “Something must have gone wrong in the investigation. This can't be true.”
entradas.menu: “Something must have gone wrong in the investigation. This can't be true.”

entradas.text: “The initial lead found by our lead investigator refers to several transactions. There is a case to pursue.”
“We can't know for sure without starting a full investigation. It could be a local case but it could be something bigger.”
“Exactly. That is why I refrain from making a final comment.”
“I never trusted HOS and Koronti anyway.”
entradas.menu: “I never trusted HOS and Koronti anyway.”

entradas.text: “My reservations regarding that family and their fortunes never changed.”
“A ledger was found in one of the raids.”
“It has contents linking their operations to a subsidiary of the Heart of Sordland Conglomerate.”
“Obviously we hope that there is nothing beneath the surface but if in any way HOS is linked to organised crime...”
“At any rate, with this new evidence we need not keep our research into Mr. Koronti a secret any longer. In fact, we should open a full-blown joint investigation with the Ministry of Justice."
“Marcel Koronti is a powerful figure that wouldn't like a development like this at all.”
entradas.menu: “Marcel Koronti is a powerful figure that wouldn't like a development like this at all.”

entradas.text: “There is no way a respectable company like HOS can be linked to this. I don't believe it.”
entradas.menu: “There is no way a respectable company like HOS can be linked to this. I don't believe it.”

entradas.text: “People like him think they are above the law.”
“I wouldn't come to you if there wasn't anything worth looking into.”
“To figure out the truth a more indepth investigation needs to be launched.”
entradas.menu: “To figure out the truth a more indepth investigation needs to be launched.”

entradas.text: “Is that really enough to start rounding up suspects?”
entradas.menu: “Is that really enough to start rounding up suspects?”

entradas.text: Lileas looked at me with suspicion.
“Agreed.”
“No. He wouldn't like it at all but if he is innocent he shouldn't care.”
“We must tread carefully. There have been rumours about Mr. Koronti having ties to our government.”
“So. Will you allow us to open an investigation?”
“We all have our ways, Mr. President. I wouldn't be sitting here if I didn't know how to keep my ears open.”
“Who did you hear that from?”
entradas.menu: “Who did you hear that from?”

entradas.text: “I'm not surprised at all.”
entradas.menu: “I'm not surprised at all.”

entradas.text: “I've personally met him once. Didn't seem like a bad guy.”
entradas.menu: “I've personally met him once. Didn't seem like a bad guy.”

entradas.text: “Regardless, the Lotherberg members aren't to be trusted.”
Lileas bursted into a laugh.
“I hope that is not just wishful thinking.”
“They always try to impress but it is all smoke and mirrors.”
“Our administration wouldn't fall that low. I have trust in our people.”
entradas.menu: “Our administration wouldn't fall that low. I have trust in our people.”

entradas.text: “You need to be careful with the oligarchs, Mr. President. Their only loyalty is to money.”
“It would be even worse if we acted too hasty and the lead turned out to be a false one.”
entradas.menu: “It would be even worse if we acted too hasty and the lead turned out to be a false one.”

entradas.text: Lileas got up from her seat and left the meeting room.
“I'll get in touch with Nia right away. Of course, I needn't mention our previous activities or the SSP's ongoing investigation into Mr. Tusk."
“I'm disappointed by this course of action. The gang might try to erase evidence in the meantime.”
We both locked eyes.
“We can't be hasty here. We will wait until we have a more concrete lead.”
entradas.menu: “We can't be hasty here. We will wait until we have a more concrete lead.”

entradas.text: “Well. That is all I had for today.”
“Thank you for your time, Mr. President.”
“I trust that we will come with enough information to incriminate him in due time.”
entradas.menu: “I trust that we will come with enough information to incriminate him in due time.”

entradas.text: “Very well. Meeting adjourned then.”
entradas.menu: “Very well. Meeting adjourned then.”

entradas.text: “Looking forward to the results. Do your best.”
entradas.menu: “Looking forward to the results. Do your best.”

entradas.text: “Hmm. You may be right, but I'd hate to find out that we missed our chance later.”
“We will.”
“Absolutely not. Keep your focus on Tusk."
entradas.menu: “Absolutely not. Keep your focus on Tusk."

entradas.text: “There is just not enough evidence to trigger an investigation.”
entradas.menu: “There is just not enough evidence to trigger an investigation.”

entradas.text: “Begin an official investigation to find out if HOS is working with organised crime elements in Estord.”
entradas.menu: “Begin an official investigation to find out if HOS is working with organised crime elements in Estord.”

entradas.text: Karl Greiser requested to set up a short meeting regarding Marcel Koronti.
He entered the meeting room and saluted.
“Karl. Good to see you. What did you want to talk about?”
entradas.menu: “Karl. Good to see you. What did you want to talk about?”

entradas.text: “This better be worth my time.”
entradas.menu: “This better be worth my time.”

entradas.text: “At ease.”
entradas.menu: “At ease.”

entradas.text: “Mr. President.”
I saluted him.
entradas.menu: Salute him.

entradas.text: “I wanted to give you an update on the current status of Marcel Koronti.”
“We have interrogated him and learned about something extremely disturbing.”
“By his account, HOS has been making deals with the Koranelli Cartel in Estord.”
“He will spend the rest of his life in prison.”
“Are you sure about this? If this is true, this is really big.”
entradas.menu: “Are you sure about this? If this is true, this is really big.”

entradas.text: “Traitor! I knew it was a good idea to put him in prison.”
entradas.menu: “Traitor! I knew it was a good idea to put him in prison.”

entradas.text: “This doesn't surprise me at all.”
entradas.menu: “This doesn't surprise me at all.”

entradas.text: “Me too, sir. It was a good idea to put him in custody.”
“I agree, sir.”
“We have his written testimony, sir. Also, we checked the connections. It all seems to add up.”
“Try to get whatever you can out from him. There might be more leads.”
entradas.menu: “Try to get whatever you can out from him. There might be more leads.”

entradas.text: “As you wish.”
“Serves him right!”
entradas.menu: “Serves him right!”

entradas.text: “Very good. Anything else?”
entradas.menu: “Very good. Anything else?”

entradas.text: “You have brought a known criminal to justice.”
“There is...”
“That is all I had for today, sir.”
“Excellent. You may leave now.”
entradas.menu: “Excellent. You may leave now.”

entradas.text: “Keep up the good work.”
entradas.menu: “Keep up the good work.”

entradas.text: “Good. We are done then. Dismissed.”
entradas.menu: “Good. We are done then. Dismissed.”

entradas.text: He saluted again and left the room.
“Thank you, Mr. President.”
“It's my duty.”
“There is something else he confessed, sir.”
“We have disregarded his remarks, obviously.”
“He was definitely lying.”
“What did he confess?”
entradas.menu: “What did he confess?”

entradas.text: “Speak, man.”
entradas.menu: “Speak, man.”

entradas.text: “Lying about what?”
entradas.menu: “Lying about what?”

entradas.text: “He...he said that he had a deal with you, sir.”
“He said he lent you his power to control the media.”
“Of course... he was lying.”
“I see. He is trying to bring me down along with himself.”
entradas.menu: “I see. He is trying to bring me down along with himself.”

entradas.text: “You will not speak a word of this to anyone. Do you understand?”
entradas.menu: “You will not speak a word of this to anyone. Do you understand?”

entradas.text: “Yes. What else did he say?”
entradas.menu: “Yes. What else did he say?”

entradas.text: “He gave further accounts on how the deal was made.”
“That is exactly what I thought, sir.”
“As you command.”
“Make sure these rumours never get out. It might create a problem.”
entradas.menu: “Make sure these rumours never get out. It might create a problem.”

entradas.text: “He does have a very wild imagination, but I did not fall for it.”
“I'm not worried. No one will believe this broken man.”
entradas.menu: “I'm not worried. No one will believe this broken man.”

entradas.text: “There is no way, sir.”
“Only a few officers who were in the area heard him.”
“I will make sure your order is conveyed and implemented.”
“That is all I had for today.”
“He is too dangerous to stay alive. I want him gone. Discreetly.”
entradas.menu: “He is too dangerous to stay alive. I want him gone. Discreetly.”

entradas.text: “Sir?”
“You heard me. Are you questioning my decision, Karl?”
entradas.menu: “You heard me. Are you questioning my decision, Karl?”

entradas.text: “He has shown that he can affect the administration even in custody.”
entradas.menu: “He has shown that he can affect the administration even in custody.”

entradas.text: “I gave you an order.”
entradas.menu: “I gave you an order.”

entradas.text: “Yes, sir. Right away.”
“No, sir. I will handle it right away.”
“Makes sense, sir. I will handle it right away.”
“Rest assured. No one will hear of this.”
“Remember. Both you and I are responsible for protecting Sordland.”
entradas.menu: “Remember. Both you and I are responsible for protecting Sordland.”

entradas.text: “That better be right. For your own good.”
entradas.menu: “That better be right. For your own good.”

entradas.text: “Thank you, Karl. You are a loyal man.”
entradas.menu: “Thank you, Karl. You are a loyal man.”

entradas.text: “I live for Sordland, sir.”
“As you command.”
“Thank you, sir.”
“That is all I had for today.”
“That brings me to the end of my report.”
“That brings me to the end of my report.”
If Marcel's cartel ties were real, this was huge news.
“Well, I don't think I can make an offer without seeing what I am buying first.”
“What are you offering for this information?”
entradas.menu: “What are you offering for this information?”

entradas.text: “Disappointing, I will find someone else to work with.”
